opportunities.title: Editor Experto en Reels, Shorts y Tiktok – Storytelling
opportunities.description: Busco editores de video de nivel experto, especializados en Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, storytelling y retención de audiencia, para formar un equipo profesional de creación de contenido a largo plazo. Mi objetivo es entregar grabaciones de mentorías en español latinoamericano de aproximadamente 60 a 90 minutos y que el editor tenga la capacidad de analizarlas, identificar los momentos más extraordinarios y transformarlos en videos verticales de 30 a 90 segundos. No busco simplemente recortar fragmentos, agregar subtítulos o aplicar efectos. Necesito profesionales con excelente criterio creativo y narrativo, capaces de encontrar ideas poderosas, mensajes de alto valor y momentos que despierten curiosidad, emoción y reflexión. Cada Reel debe funcionar como un video independiente, con un comienzo que capte inmediatamente la atención, un desarrollo coherente y un cierre memorable. Busco edición profesional con subtítulos dinámicos, excelente sonido, ritmo atractivo, efectos visuales cuando aporten valor y formato vertical 9:16. Es fundamental comprender profundamente el español latinoamericano y preservar siempre el significado y contexto original de mis mensajes. Requisitos: experiencia comprobable editando Reels, Shorts y TikToks de alto nivel, portfolio profesional, creatividad excepcional, storytelling, capacidad de trabajar de forma independiente y cumplimiento de plazos. Ofrezco remuneración competitiva, pruebas de edición pagas para candidatos preseleccionados y oportunidades de colaboración a largo plazo con proyectos recurrentes. Busco editores extraordinarios que sepan transformar una mentoría extensa en contenido corto, valioso y memorable. opportunities.title: Anime Motion Comic VFX
opportunities.description: I’m producing a motion-comic style anime film and have the panel artwork ready; what I’m missing is the animation magic that turns static frames into a living scene. I need someone who can take each illustrated panel and add movement, depth-of-field camera work, lighting passes, particles, smooth transitions—everything that gives the project a cinematic feel. Your work will cover all animation and visual-effects tasks, from prepping the layers through to final compositing and export in a high-quality video format. If you’re comfortable in After Effects, Premiere, Blender, or comparable tools and have a reel that shows atmospheric lighting and particle work, I’d love to see it. Once hired, we’ll lock down: • File hand-off format and resolution • A short test scene for style alignment • Milestones for rough cut, revisions, and final master If you can give my panels the polish of an animated film trailer—subtle camera pans, flowing particles, dramatic lighting—let’s talk.

opportunities.title: Build Roblox Simulator Empire
opportunities.description: # Roblox Simulator Game Development – Hiring a Developer I am looking for an experienced Roblox Game Developer to create a high-quality Simulator game for my Roblox platform. **Project Name:** Simulator Empire **Budget:** ₹10,000–₹25,000 **Estimated Timeline:** 3–4 weeks ### Required Features 1. Player Training System – Players can train and earn power. 2. Coins System – Players can sell their power to earn coins. 3. Upgrade Shop – Players can purchase upgrades. 4. Pet System – Egg hatching, different pets and pet multipliers. 5. Rebirth System – Players can reset progress and receive permanent boosts. 6. World Unlock System – Multiple unlockable worlds. 7. Daily Rewards – Daily login rewards. 8. Quest System – Tasks and achievements. 9. Leaderboard – Global player rankings. 10. Data Saving – Secure player progress saving. 11. Monetization – VIP Gamepass, 2x Coins, Luck Boost and Developer Products. 12. Mobile & PC Support – Fully responsive gameplay and UI. ### Design Requirements - Modern and attractive Roblox Simulator UI. - High-quality 3D map and environment. - Smooth animations and gameplay. - Professional icons and buttons. - Optimized performance for mobile and PC. ### Developer Requirements - Strong Roblox Studio and Luau scripting experience. - Previous Simulator game development experience. - Experience with DataStore and monetization. - Must provide previous game portfolio. ### Important Conditions - I must own the complete game and source files. - All scripts and assets must be handed over. - The game must be published under my Roblox account or my controlled group. - No malicious scripts or unauthorized third-party assets. - Development will be paid in milestones after reviewing deliverables. - Developer must provide bug fixes before final handover. **Please include in your proposal:** 1. Previous Roblox games you have developed. 2. Your total development cost. 3. Estimated delivery time. 4. What features are included in your price. 5. Whether you can provide complete source files. I am looking for a long-term development partner if the first project is successful.

opportunities.title: Create Premium E-books for Indian Consumers
opportunities.description: # Freelancer Project: Create 3 Premium E-books for an Indian Consumer Audience **Project Overview** I am looking to hire an experienced e-book writer/designer or a small team to create three professionally written, researched and designed e-books for the Indian market. The objective is to build a digital e-book brand targeting everyday Indian consumers. The books should be practical, engaging, visually appealing and easy for ordinary readers to understand. ## The Three E-books **1. Scam-Proof Your Family** - UPI and banking scams - WhatsApp and SMS fraud - Fake customer care calls - Online shopping fraud - Phishing links and OTP scams - Practical steps to protect family members **2. AI for Everyday Indians** - Using ChatGPT and other AI tools - AI for students and job seekers - AI for working professionals - AI for productivity and everyday tasks - Practical prompts and real-life examples - Beginner-friendly step-by-step instructions **3. The Middle-Class Money Playbook** - Monthly budgeting - Managing EMIs and debt - Saving money effectively - Common financial mistakes - Understanding insurance and investments - Practical personal finance habits ## Scope of Work I expect the freelancer to handle: 1. Research and develop the complete content for all three books. 2. Create compelling titles, subtitles and chapter structures. 3. Write original, well-researched and easy-to-understand content. 4. Include practical examples, checklists, actionable tips and illustrations wherever appropriate. 5. Design professional, premium-looking covers. 6. Format the books professionally for mobile and desktop reading. 7. Deliver final PDFs and editable source files. 8. opportunities.title: 5-Axis CNC CAD Machining Expert
opportunities.description: About the project We are looking for an experienced mechanical design engineer with CNC machining knowledge to turn hand-drawn sketches, photos and caliper measurements into a production-ready 3D CAD model and manufacturing drawings for a custom one-piece, heavily skeletonized aluminum stock (aftermarket furniture, tight drop-in fit). The project owner is not an engineer, so the sketches are rough. We need someone who can interpret them, ask smart questions, and deliver a clean, machinable design. What you will do Build a full 3D CAD model from supplied sketches, photos, measurements and reference drawings Merge the original two-piece layout (main body plus front hand guard) into a single-piece stock Design M-LOK cutouts and skeletonized pockets for weight reduction Design internal mounting with pass-through bolt holes to a mini scout mount on the barrel Design the rear interface for an EBR CQB Mod-1 style buttstock, with unthreaded pass-through holes and partial counterbores Optimize the design for 5-axis CNC machining (tool access, fixturing, wall thickness, internal radii) Deliver CAD files and 2D drawings; optionally, 5-axis CNC programming and machining of a prototype

opportunities.title: Ignition PLC Integration & Operator Screens
opportunities.description: We’re building a SCADA application in Ignition (Inductive Automation, Perspective module) to replace a legacy HMI on an industrial process system, and we need an experienced Ignition developer to help carry it across the finish line. Current status: 40 of 65 operator screens are built. We need the remaining 25 screens completed, plus several platform features finished off. Scope of work: Complete ~25 remaining Perspective screens — consistent with the design and layout of the 40 already built. Finish tag binding on some existing screens where bindings are still incomplete (working from a provided tag list). User management — role-based access control, login, user roles/permissions. Audit trail — logging of operator actions and parameter changes (who / what / when / old value → new value). Report creation — batch/record reports generated from the project database. You should have: Proven Ignition Perspective experience (please share examples).

opportunities.title: Hologram Fan Product Reveal
opportunities.description: I need a short, looping 3D video that will play cleanly on my hologram LED fan. The clip must open with my product slowly rotating in mid-air, then transition into a stylish reveal of my logo before looping seamlessly. All I can supply up front is a single reference photo and a short written description, so you will have to build the 3D model from scratch, texture it realistically, light it for maximum depth, and animate the smooth rotation. I’m after that crisp, floating look people expect from hologram fans, so please optimise colours, contrast and background transparency accordingly. Deliverables • Finished video ready for hologram fan playback (MP4 or the fan’s native format, 720×720px, 30 fps, 15–20 sec loop) • Source project files (Blender, Cinema 4D, or comparable) so I can request tweaks later • One still frame at full quality for marketing materials Acceptance criteria • My product recognisably modelled and textured in 3D • Logo appears clearly during the reveal without obscuring the product • Clean loop—no visible jump when the video restarts • Tested on a hologram fan emulator (or actual fan if you have one) with proof of playback Software is your choice—Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, Houdini—so long as the final file meets the specs above. Let me know your preferred toolset, typical turnaround, and how many revisions you include.

opportunities.title: Card-Playing Android Game Bot
opportunities.description: I need a lightweight bot that sits on top of an Android game and automatically plays cards according to a specific strategy. The gameplay logic is already defined—I’ll share clear screen-recorded videos and annotated screenshots that show exactly which card should be played in every game situation. Your job is to translate that visual strategy into reliable, repeatable automation. The solution may hook into the game through an accessibility service, ADB scripting, Auto.js, or any other non-intrusive method you prefer, as long as it does not require root and keeps the account safe. Image recognition or coordinate tapping are both acceptable; accuracy and speed matter more than the underlying toolset. Deliverables • Fully functional bot or plugin (APK or script) that detects the current hand and plays the correct card based on the strategy in my videos • Easy way for me to adjust timing or screen coordinates if the UI changes slightly • Source code with brief inline comments • A short setup guide so I can install, run, and, if needed, retrain the image templates on a different device Acceptance criteria The bot must complete ten consecutive matches on my test device while following the provided strategy with at least 95 % move accuracy and without crashing or triggering in-game warnings. If you have questions about edge cases, send me a quick clip request and I’ll capture additional footage to clarify.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40811604, publicado hace 8 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: Contact-Driven WordPress Landing Page -- 2
opportunities.description: I run a small service-based business and I need a single WordPress landing page that pushes visitors to reach me immediately. The page’s primary goal is to prompt a phone call or a WhatsApp chat, so the design should keep that button visible and compelling on both desktop and mobile. Content will revolve around a clear headline, a short overview of my core services, and a concise list of the benefits clients gain when working with me. No extra sections are required beyond that focus, but layout, copy placement, and color choices must all reinforce a direct “call or message now” action. Please build the page inside my existing WordPress install. I’m happy with Elementor or Gutenberg blocks—whatever you find fastest—so long as the final result is lightweight, responsive, and easy for me to tweak later. Once complete, hand over: • A fully functional landing page with hero section, services & benefits copy, and a sticky phone/WhatsApp button • Any custom CSS or assets used • Brief instructions on how I can change text, images, and the phone number in the future If you’ve created high-converting, contact-centric pages before, I’d love to see an example.

opportunities.title: 3D Handshake Relief CAD
opportunities.description: I need a clean, production-ready 3D model of a 300 × 200 × 30 mm aluminium plate featuring a deep-relief (11–15 mm) handshake in the centre. The hands must look highly realistic, with individual fingers, skin folds and neat shirt cuffs, sitting on a recessed background framed by a raised outer border. The file has to be fully machinable on a 3-axis VMC, so please keep every surface draft-friendly and avoid undercuts. Once complete I will run the model straight into CAM, so STEP format is mandatory. Deliverables • Final STEP file of the full plate • High-resolution renders for approval before hand-off When you reply, include two or three images of similar CNC relief work you have done, along with your price and the time you need to deliver the finished STEP.

opportunities.title: Custom Pool Cue Design Website
opportunities.description: I need a complete ecommerce site where visitors can design their own pool cues, see the results in real time, and purchase instantly. Key features • Interactive 3-D configurator – the cue must render live and be fully rotatable so shoppers can inspect every angle before checkout. • Deep custom options – colours, patterns, wrap style, cue length, weight, tip type, plus space for names, text or even user-uploaded graphics. All selections should update the 3-D model on the fly. • Seamless checkout – once finished, customers pay online with any mainstream card or digital wallet. Deliverables 1. Responsive website (preferably on a well-supported platform such as WooCommerce, Shopify or a custom React/Laravel stack) with the 3-D configurator integrated. 2. Admin dashboard to add or edit cue components, pricing rules and promotional codes. 3. Payment gateway setup (Stripe, PayPal or similar) with order confirmation emails and secure SSL. 4. Exportable production file or database entry containing every chosen spec so manufacturing can begin immediately. 5. Brief hand-over session plus basic documentation so I can maintain catalogue items myself. I’m open to your suggested toolset as long as the configurator is smooth on desktop and mobile, load times stay minimal, and the checkout remains friction-less. If you have examples of previous product builders or 3-D e-commerce work, please include them with your proposal.

opportunities.title: CNC Upholstered Furniture Frame Engineer
opportunities.description: # Upholstered Furniture Design Engineer & CNC Specialist – Long-Term Cooperation We are **MonoSpace**, an upholstered furniture manufacturing company based in Astana, Kazakhstan. We are looking for an **experienced Upholstered Furniture Design Engineer / Furniture Production Technologist** with strong practical knowledge of sofa, bed, and ottoman manufacturing, including CNC plywood frame design. Our goal is to develop a standardized collection of upholstered furniture suitable for efficient serial production. ### Project Scope We plan to develop: - 5 upholstered sofa models - 5 upholstered bed models - 5 ottoman models ### Key Responsibilities - Develop complete furniture frame structures for sofas, beds, and ottomans. - Design plywood frames using 12 mm or 15 mm plywood, depending on structural requirements. - Integrate sofa transformation mechanisms, including Puma, Tik-Tak, Dolphin, and other suitable systems. - Understand upholstery construction, foam placement, seat support systems, and furniture assembly. - Optimize frame designs for CNC cutting and efficient plywood consumption. - Develop standardized, strong, durable, and easy-to-assemble furniture structures. - Recommend practical manufacturing solutions to reduce production costs and assembly time. ### Required Deliverables 1. Complete 3D CAD models of furniture frames. 2. Detailed 2D manufacturing drawings with dimensions. 3. CNC-ready DXF files for plywood cutting. 4. Optimized plywood nesting layouts. 5. Assembly drawings and instructions. 6. Bill of Materials (BOM), including plywood, hardware, and other components. 7. Technical specifications for furniture mechanisms and mounting points. 8. Editable CAD source files. 9. Recommendations for improving production efficiency. ### Required Experience - Proven experience in upholstered furniture manufacturing and engineering. - Practical knowledge of sofa and bed frame construction. - Experience with CNC routers and plywood cutting. - Understanding of upholstery technology, foam, springs, and sofa transformation mechanisms. - Proficiency in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar CAD software. - Experience designing furniture for serial manufacturing. **We are looking for a furniture production specialist, not just a 3D visualizer. Practical manufacturing experience is essential.** ### Cooperation Approach We would like to begin with **one paid test project involving a complete sofa frame with a Puma transformation mechanism**. After reviewing the drawings and successfully testing the frame in production, we plan to continue with the remaining 14 furniture models. ### When Applying, Please Provide 1. Examples of upholstered furniture projects you have previously developed. 2. Photos of actual manufactured sofa or bed frames. 3. Experience with CNC plywood frame production. 4. Experience with sofa transformation mechanisms. 5. Your price per furniture model. 6. Estimated delivery time. 7. CAD software used and available file formats. We are interested in establishing **long-term cooperation with a qualified upholstered furniture engineer** who can support the development of our furniture production line.

opportunities.title: UAE National Day 3D Animation using AI
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a 3D animator to create a **45–60 second animated short** for a Grade 7 UAE National Day competition. The theme is **“The Future of the Emirates.”** The video should show how students can make their school greener while conserving water. **Working title:** «منصور وحديقة الغد» (*Mansoor and the Garden of Tomorrow*) **Story and scenes** 1. **School entrance.** Open with a recognizable 3D cartoon version of the Australian school entrance, using a reference photo I’ll provide. Show the Arabic title and the theme «إمارات المستقبل». 2. **Football.** Mansoor and his brother Hamad play football in the school courtyard. Their ball rolls into a dry, unused corner. When they go to retrieve it, Mansoor imagines turning the space into a garden. 3. **Designing the garden.** Their brother Rashid builds a miniature garden with LEGO, prints a simple outline of the plan on the blank side of a used sheet of paper, and colors it. Their sister Reem draws native UAE plants on the plan. 4. **The future garden.** The LEGO model transforms into a 3D preview of the proposed garden in the same courtyard. A close-up shows drip irrigation delivering water near the plants’ roots. End with all four siblings, the UAE flag, and the Arabic message «كل عام والإمارات بخير». **Character style and references** Mansoor is the main character. Hamad, Rashid, and Reem are supporting characters. I’ll privately share reference photos of all four children and the school entrance. Please create expressive **3D cartoon characters that closely resemble the real children**, especially in their facial features, skin tones, and hairstyles. Send one still image of all four characters together for a quick likeness check before completing the animation. No filming is needed. **Language and voice-over** The project brief is in English, but **the video, titles, and on-screen text must be in Arabic**. Mansoor will record the Arabic narration **in his own voice** and send it separately. Please animate the story using gestures and expressions so the narration can be added later as a voice-over. No lip-sync or AI-generated voice is needed. **Deadline and deliverables** - Deliver the animated version **today, 10 November 2026, by 8:00 PM UAE time (UTC+4)**. - Deliver a **landscape MP4, 1920 × 1080, without a watermark**. If the narration has not arrived by the deadline, deliver the animation on time and add Mansoor’s recording afterward as one included revision. - Keep the children’s photos and video private and use them only for this project. Please do not publish the work or use it in your portfolio. **In your bid, please include your fixed price, earliest delivery time in UAE time, and one relevant example of a 3D cartoon character created from a real photo.** Please confirm that your price includes the character preview and the final version with Mansoor’s voice-over.

opportunities.title: Portal de Reservas para Casa Vacacional
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar un sitio web propio para mi casa de renta vacacional que permita a cualquier huésped elegir fechas disponibles, pagar el total de la estancia en el momento y recibir la confirmación automática. Todo debe funcionar con pagos en línea seguros —pienso en Stripe o PayPal, aunque estoy abierto a sugerencias— y emitir los correos de confirmación y recibos correspondientes. Necesito que el calendario se sincronice a dos vías con mi anuncio de Airbnb, no solo para mostrar disponibilidad: también debe importar y exportar precios, reservas ya hechas y los mensajes de los huéspedes para evitar doble trabajo. Si hay variaciones de tarifa, temporadas o descuentos, quiero poder actualizarlos yo mismo desde un panel claro y que se reflejen tanto en mi web como en Airbnb. Desde el mismo panel de administración debo: • revisar y gestionar reservas, pagos y calendario en tiempo real • modificar precios, temporadas y cupones sin depender de un desarrollador • crear promociones rápidamente y publicarlas en redes sociales, incluyendo TikTok, Facebook e Instagram, con un par de clics El sitio debe cargarse rápido, ser responsive y quedar bien indexado por Google para captar tráfico orgánico. Agradeceré que la estructura y los textos clave vengan optimizados para SEO básico y que me indiques cómo añadir más contenido después. Entrego branding, fotos y detalles de la propiedad; tú te encargas de diseño, desarrollo, pasarela de pago, conexión con Airbnb y la herramienta de publicación social. Prefiero WordPress + WooCommerce + channel manager compatible, pero escucharé otras stacks si justificas las ventajas. Al finalizar espero: 1.Gestion multiple para enviar publicidad a redes y google 2. Pasarela de pago operativa y reserva 100 % en línea funcionando 3. Sincronización completa con Airbnb verificada 4. Tutorial breve (video o PDF) para que pueda gestionar todo sin asistencia Si tienes experiencia demostrable en sitios de booking vacacional y saber conectar con Airbnb, envíame ejemplos y tu plan de trabajo.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp-Shopify Automation Setup
opportunities.description: Quiero que todo el flujo de atención al cliente por WhatsApp quede completamente automatizado y conectado con mi tienda de Shopify. El bot debe: • Responder de inmediato las preguntas frecuentes sobre productos, variantes y existencias tomando la información actual de mi catálogo en Shopify. • Enviar cotizaciones con los precios fijos que ya manejo en la tienda, darles seguimiento y reactivar al cliente si no responde. • Cuando el cliente confirme la compra, generar el pedido directamente en Shopify y devolver por WhatsApp el enlace de pago correspondiente. Me sirve cualquier enfoque que combine la API de WhatsApp Business con Shopify (por ejemplo, Twilio, Meta Cloud API, o un desarrollo propio en Node.js/Python) siempre que sea estable y fácil de mantener. Entrego acceso a mi cuenta de WhatsApp Business y a la API de Shopify; espero de tu parte el flujo configurado, documentación breve sobre cómo modificar mensajes o reglas, y una prueba en vivo que demuestre: 1. Consulta de stock respondida en tiempo real. 2. Cotización emitida con precio exacto desde Shopify. 3. Pedido creado y enlace de pago enviado automáticamente. Si ya has hecho algo similar, mencióname qué stack usaste y cuánto tardarías en implementarlo.

opportunities.title: Importación AliExpress-Shopify Masiva
opportunities.description: Necesito optimizar mi tienda Shopify para añadir rápidamente una gran cantidad de artículos de AliExpress que yo misma iré seleccionando. Busco una solución — sea configuración de una app existente (DSers, AliExpress Dropshipping, Zendrop, etc.) o un desarrollo a medida — que me permita: • Importar solo los productos que elija, pero de forma masiva, y que al traerlos se copie absolutamente toda la información disponible: imágenes, títulos, descripciones, variantes, modelos, precios, stock y opciones de envío. • Una vez que entren pedidos en Shopify, estos deben crearse de forma automática en AliExpress con todos los datos del cliente listos para pagar, sin que yo tenga que intervenir manualmente. Entrego acceso a la tienda y a la cuenta de AliExpress. El trabajo se considera completo cuando pueda: 1. Seleccionar varios enlaces de AliExpress y verlos publicados en Shopify con la información íntegra y bien formateada. 2. Recibir un pedido de prueba en Shopify y confirmarlo levantado automáticamente en AliExpress listo para el pago. Incluye breve guía en video o PDF mostrando cómo repetir el proceso y resolver posibles errores.

opportunities.title: Difusión Shopify en Redes Sociales
opportunities.description: Necesito automatizar y ejecutar la publicación masiva de todo mi catálogo de Shopify — organizado por categorías — en TikTok, Instagram y Facebook. El objetivo es que cada producto se muestre en los tres formatos que más convierten para mi tienda: • Imágenes publicitarias con su precio y la oferta vigente. • Videos cortos que muestren el producto en uso, listos para TikTok/Reels. • Publicaciones con fotos y descripciones completas extraídas del catálogo. Entrego acceso a Shopify y a los perfiles sociales; tú te encargas de seleccionar la mejor herramienta o flujo (puede ser nativo de Shopify, apps de programación o tu propio sistema) para que el proceso quede lo más automatizado posible. Espero artes finales optimizados en tamaño y proporción para cada red, copys persuasivos en español e inglés si fuera necesario y programación del contenido en un calendario inicial de prueba. Acepto propuestas que incluyan: 1. Plan de trabajo con hitos claros para cada red. 2. Ejemplos de piezas visuales antes de publicarlas. 3. Métricas mínimas que medirás para confirmar que el contenido se publica correctamente (impresiones, clicks, etc.). Cuando terminemos la fase de publicación, el objetivo es que el flujo quede documentado para yo poder continuar programando contenido futuro por mi cuenta o repetir la estrategia en nuevas colecciones.

opportunities.title: Traductor Comercial São Paulo
opportunities.description: Necesito incorporar a quien combine traducción con gestión comercial para nuestro próximo impulso de mercado en São Paulo. El trabajo gira en torno al portugués, ya que todas las llamadas y presentaciones a potenciales clientes—empresas del sector industrial—se harán en ese idioma. Lo que harás en el día a día: llamar a prospectos, presentarles brevemente nuestra empresa, recabar sus datos de contacto detallados y mantener un registro limpio y exportable; además, asistirás a ferias y rondas de negocios que se realicen en la ciudad para ampliar la lista de leads. Valoro que vivas en la propia capital paulista para que la logística de las ferias resulte sencilla. Si tu lengua materna es portugués o español y te sientes cómodo vendiendo en portugués con tono profesional, encajarás perfecto. Entrego guiones base, material corporativo y acceso a nuestro CRM; espero de tu parte reportes semanales y la base de datos actualizada como entregable principal. Cualquier duda que tengas sobre la empresa o el enfoque, la resolvemos antes de empezar para que puedas trabajar con total claridad.

opportunities.title: Social Media Manager, UGC Content Creator & Video Editor – Family Travel Brand
opportunities.description: Project Type: Long-term opportunity (starting with a paid trial) Category: Social Media Marketing | Video Editing | UGC Content Creation | Content Strategy Project Overview We are an Australian family of three launching a new travel brand across Instagram and TikTok. We have an extensive collection of travel photos, videos and drone footage from our adventures around the world, which we have recently finished organizing. We are looking for a creative, experienced freelancer who can help us turn our travel content into a successful, income-generating social media business. Our main goal is to monetize our content through UGC brand deals, paid collaborations, sponsored travel and affiliate marketing, while growing an engaged social media audience. We are not simply looking for someone to edit videos. We want someone who understands how to create engaging content, build a recognizable brand and develop opportunities for monetization. Our Content Focus Our brand will feature: - Family travel and adventure: Beautiful destinations, luxury resorts, affordable travel, unique experiences and drone footage. - Neurodivergent family travel: Sharing the challenges, rewards, funny moments and practical strategies involved in travelling the world as a neurodivergent family. - UGC content: Professional, authentic promotional videos designed to attract partnerships with hotels, resorts, tourism operators and travel brands. - Affiliate marketing: Featuring useful travel products, sensory-friendly products and other items relevant to neurodivergent families. Skills We're Looking For Ideally, our freelancer will have experience in: - Professional video and photo editing, including cinematic travel Reels. - Instagram and TikTok content creation and growth strategies. - UGC video creation and content suitable for brand advertising. - Social media marketing, storytelling, hooks, captions and trending content. - Brand partnerships, UGC portfolios and monetization strategies. - Affiliate marketing and integrating products naturally into content. - AI-assisted editing tools and efficient content production workflows. Experience working with travel, family or lifestyle brands would be highly regarded. Initial Trial Project We would like to begin with three professionally edited Reels to assess creativity, editing quality and understanding of our brand. 1. Cinematic Travel Reel: Showcasing beautiful destinations, resorts, adventures and drone footage. 2. Family Introduction Reel: Introducing our family and our neurodivergent travel experiences in a fun, relatable and engaging way. 3. UGC-Style Promotional Reel: Featuring a specific hotel, resort or travel experience, demonstrating the type of professional content we could create for paying brands. We will provide the original footage, photographs, drone videos and branding materials. We welcome creative suggestions regarding music, voiceovers, storytelling and presentation. Any music used for commercial UGC must have appropriate licensing. Long-Term Opportunity If the trial is successful, we hope to establish an ongoing working relationship.
